# Clinilabs names Shannon as new CEO, promotes founder Zammit to executive chairperson

Laura Shannon (right) joins Clinilabs as CEO, as Gary Zammit, Ph.D., assumes the role of Executive Chairperson. - Clinilabs

Clinilabs, a specialty contract research organization (CRO) focused on central nervous system (CNS) drug and device development, announced Aug. 13 an expansion of its leadership team.

Laura Shannon joins the organization as chief executive officer, as Gary Zammit, the company’s founder, assumes the role of executive chairperson. This expansion of the senior leadership team is a recognition of a growing organization with global capabilities and continuing commitment to advancing treatments for patients with psychiatric and neurological disorders. [...] “Laura’s many years of biopharma leadership, track record of building high-performing teams, and deep expertise in commercial strategy and alliance management make her exceptionally well-suited to lead Clinilabs into its next chapter of growth.”

Throughout her career, Shannon has held broad global leadership roles across large and midsize pharma, emerging biopharma and medtech companies.

#### Related Articles

### Daybright Financial of Iselin adds ACAPrime, bolstering ACA compliance capabilities

### Saint Peter’s University Hospital gets nationally recognized by AHA for stroke care

### Made Scientific announces MOU with NurExone for U.S. manufacturing and commercial supply partnership

### Tris Pharma expands support for those with ADHD via Calm Health and ADHD Central partnerships [...] Shannon has more than 30 years of experience in the biopharma industry. The company says she is known for her ability to build high-performing teams, forge strategic alliances, and drive growth across complex organizations.

Most recently serving as executive vice president and chief commercial officer of the U.S. and Canada regional business units at IQVIA, where she led a nationwide multibillion-dollar sales and account management team across research and development, real-world solutions and commercial solutions.

“It has been the privilege of a lifetime to lead this remarkable organization and to work alongside a team so deeply committed to improving the lives of patients with neurological disorders,” said Zammit.
